policy.canonicalIdentity: Encoded tuple: schoolId + NFC/whitespace/case-normalized code + name + origin + exact sorted raw source-school-code scope (null means unknown)
policy.floorProvenance: Optional floorSources/floorSourceRefs are validated separately by year, exact value/method/scale, source-school scope and program-or-school code. They never enter the identity tuple or change the original cutoff source count
policy.sourceSchoolCodes: Mã trường trong nguồn; retain every campus/source alias; potentially distinct scopes are not merged or asserted to identify the same campus/institution
policy.preservation: Imported row IDs, raw labels, columns, individual point values, Excel references and public school URLs are unchanged
policy.catalogueComparison: Exact normalized code/name comparison only. Differences are reported for review and are never silently assigned or fuzzy-merged
policy.updatePolicy: Run this audit again after any source import; generated report has no time-dependent fields
